Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Deandra Dottin and Hayley Matthews, two experienced campaigners will pen the innings for Barbados Women. Renuka Singh to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

Barbados Women have allowed two big partnerships to take the game away from them. They were decent in patches but when it mattered the most, they allowed the opposition to run away with a stand. Right then! A do-or-die match for India and the batters have done an excellent job. Barbados have a job in their hands to survive in the competition. An exciting second essay is coming up. Stay tuned.

India will be happy with this score! At one point, 160 was looking easy but Shafali Verma's run out proved to be a pivotal point in the innings. Verma gave a good start and built a good stand with Jemimah Rodrigues but the partnership was paralyzed due to a bit of miscommunication. After that, it looked like India will be well short of their target but Rodrigues played until the end and she along with Deepti Sharma did an excellent job to get India past the 160 mark.

What an innings by Jemimah Rodrigues! This is her first fifty in 21 innings! Jemimah Rodrigues was not in the best of form but she played an excellent innings to put India in a decent position to win! The way she paced her innings and also while wickets were falling at the other end shows enormous maturity!

FOUR! Smart batting! This is a full delivery on off, Jemimah Rodrigues moves across again and slog-sweeps it towards the vacant deep square leg region for a boundary. India Women finishes their innings with a boundary and ends up on 162/4.

A fuller one, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and slashes this one towards deep cover. They run the first one fast and come back for the second one. Jemimah Rodrigues dives in to make her. The keeper collects the throw and whips the bails off. The third umpire checks for a run out here. Jemimah Rodrigues had grounded her bat before the bails were removed. A close call though! Not out it is!
Leg bye! On a length, around middle and off. Deepti Sharma looks to hoick this one but she misses. The ball deflects off her thigh pad and goes towards point. A leg bye taken!

Run out appeal! Jemimah Rodrigues is running at the danger end. She dives but the replay shows her bat was a bit in the air. The TV umpire watches it frame by frame and makes the decision. Not out it is! Jemimah Rodrigues had grounded her bat before the bails were removed.

Fifty up for Jemimah Rodrigues. What an innings it has been under pressure. This is on a good length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues moves across and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a brace. Wait...it is called a no ball for overstepping. This is not going to plan at all for the Barbados Women in the last over. Free Hit coming up!
This is on a length and way outside off, it is called a wide.
Fuller again and on off, Deepti Sharma pushes this towards mid off for a single. Jemimah Rodrigues is back on strike.
In the air but safe! This is short and on off, Deepti Sharma pulls it high in the air toward deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken. With that, the 150 comes up for India.
FOUR! THUMPED! This is full and on outside off, Deepti Sharma shuffles across and thumps it towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. This is poor bowling.
WIDE! Starts the last over with a full delivery on off, way outside off. It is called a wide. Not the ideal start for Barbados Women there.
Barbados Women have failed to bowl their full quota in the given period of time for the second time in the tournament! They will have one less fielder outside the ring.
A low full toss, outside off. Deepti Sharma drives it towards cover for a single.
Play and a miss! On a length, outside off. Deepti Sharma swings her bat wildly but she fails to get any connection on it.

Wide of off, overpitched delivery. Deepti Sharma brings her bat down in time and pushes it towards deep point. Two taken! That brings up the 50-run stand between these two! The third umpire checks, if Deepti Sharma has taken a short run there. But she seems fine!
Tight single! A low full toss, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues miscues her drive towards mid off and runs across to the other end.
Yorker now, outside off. Deepti Sharma digs this one out towards third man for a single.

Excellent stop! A length ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma makes room and carves this one towards deep cover. Kyshona Knight runs to her left, sticks her left out, and makes a terrific stop. Saved two runs there!

Good fielding in the deep there. This is back of a length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues punches it over covers. The fielder at deep point runs to her right and dives well to stop the ball and keeps it down to two.
A full toss on the leg stump, Deepti Sharma flicks it hard but on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder for a single.
Full again and on middle, Deepti Sharma tries to go for the same shot but cannot connect well this time. The ball goes in the air and falls into the deep mid-wicket region. Two runs taken.
SIX! MASSIVE! A full delivery and on middle, in the slot as well, Deepti Sharma stays there and smashes it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
BEATEN! This is on a length and on off, Deepti Sharma comes down the track to pull it but misses it completely.
This is full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues moves across and lofts it to long on for a single.
A yorker-length delivery, outside off. Deepti Sharma fails to squeeze this one out. 8 runs off Deandra Dottin's first over!
Good running! Full again, wide of off. Deepti Sharma slices it towards deep point. Tow taken!
Wide of off, pitches it up again. Deepti Sharma makes room and looks to cut this away but she fails to reach the ball.
FOUR! This time she connects well! Fuller one again, around off. Deepti Sharma heaves it high and over mid on for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A fuller one, outside off. Deepti Sharma swings her bat and tries to go over mid on but she fails to get any bat on it.
TWO WIDES! Deandra Dottin spills this one down the leg side, fuller ball. Jemimah Rodrigues misses her flick, Kycia Knight behind the stumps fails to grab the ball cleanly. Another run taken!
Deandra Dottin begins with a low full toss, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and tries to slash this one but she gets a slight outside edge onto the ground and back to the keeper.
Bowls this on a length from 'round the wicket and on off, Deepti Sharma punches it to mid off from her back foot.
Full and outside off, way outside off. It is called a wide.
TAP AND RUN! A good-length delivery on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it with soft hands to the off side and scampers across for a single.
FOUR! This is really good batting from Jemimah Rodrigues. This is on a length and on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and smashes it over extra-cover for another boundary.
Good length and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues tries sweep it away to the leg side but gets hit on the helmet off her bat. A mandatory concussion check is going on now.
SIX! BANG! This is on a length and on middle and leg, Jemimah Rodrigues dances down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Full delivery down the leg, Deepti Sharma works it through square leg for one.
Another single to end the over! 9 runs off the over! Length and on off. Sharma pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
Pushed full and Rodrigues sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! 100 up for India! High time for Jemimah Rodrigues to change the gears now. This is floated on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues uses her feet and lofts it over the bowler's head for four.
Slightly short and outside off, worked to sweeper cover for a single.
This is full and outside off. Rodrigues steps down and across to smash it to long off for a single.
Flatter and spinning on middle. Sharma turns it to deep square leg for a single.
TAP AND RUN! A single to end the over! Touch fuller and outside off. Sharma pushes it wide of covers for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Sharma plays it to point.
Short of a length and angling outside off at 95 clicks. Sharma slashes at it but misses.
Fuller and outside off. Blocked out.
Length ball on middle. Rodrigues works it to mid on for one more.
Shorter and it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Deepti Sharma walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Just when India were trying to change the gears, Barbados Women strike. Taniya Bhatia was under pressure as she was struggling to get going. This is full and outside off, again with a lack of pace. Bhatia tries to hoick it across the line but mistimes and the ball goes off the leading edge towards the silly point region. Deandra Dottin runs in from backward point, stumbles on her first attempt but holds onto it in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off. Rodrigues nudges with soft hands and gets to the other end.
Fuller ball, outside off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Angles one full on off. Rodrigues helps it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for India after quite a while. This is way too full and way outside off. Rodrigues frees her arms and lifts it over covers for four.
Slightly short and outside off. Bhatia steps across and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Follows Bhatia on the leg side. She drills it to long on for a single. Boundaries have dried up for India.
Just short! A juicy half-volley, around off. Bhatia tries to clear mid-wicket but does so without any power and she hits it to mid-wicket where the fielder collects it on a bounce.
Slants one full and on leg. Bhatia bunts it straight to short mid-wicket.
Length and on off. Bhatia plays it back to the bowler.
Selman keeps on delivering without any pace, this one is on a length and Bhatia punches it to covers.
On a length and on middle. Rodrigues drops it to covers and scampers across for a quick single.
Shorter and on top of off. Rodrigues pulls it to deep square leg for a single. India Women need to build a partnership now.
Flights this one, full and outside off, eased down to long on for a single.
On a length and on middle. Rodrigues nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and on middle. Bhatia tucks it to mid on for a single.
This is full and outside off, it straightens off the deck. Bhatia looks to push but misses.
Flatter and outside off, slower. It is cut to point.
A slower ball, on a length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues mistimes her drive towards the right of the cover fielder.
Full again and on middle, shaping in this time, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down.
Taniya Bhatia gets off the mark straightaway. This is a full delivery on off, shaping away, Taniya Bhatia drives it through covers for a single.
Taniya Bhatia is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! A huge moment for Barbados Women! Shakera Selman has got the massive wicket of the Indian skipper here!  A length ball, tailing back in a tad, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to flick this one but she misses and gets pinged on her pads. A loud shout for LBW, and the umpire raises her finger! Harmanpreet Kaur opts for a review. Nothing on UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates three reds! Harmanpreet Kaur departs without troubling the scorers.
On a length again, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues slashes it towards sweeper cover for a single.

Another mix-up... but no harm done! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues taps it towards backward point. She wanted a single there but she is sent back. Deandra Dottin fails to pick up the ball cleanly which allows Jemimah Rodrigues to return back home safely.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks out.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and Shafali Verma has to go back. This is full and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it towards deep mid-wicket. They cross for the run but Shafali Verma wants the second and starts running towards the non-striker's end. However, Jemimah Rodrigues denies it early but Shafali Verma keeps running without looking at her partner. Kyshona Knight there picks up the ball and throws it to the keeper Kycia Knight and she takes the bails off. Shafali Verma is nowhere near the crease and has to make the long walk back to the hut. A disaster for India and Barbados are delighted.
Pushed through a bit quicker and on off, Shafali Verma flicks it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is a bit short and on off, Shafali Verma makes room and guides it well past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues leans on and works it through square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, Shafali Verma moves across and eases it towards long on for a single.
Starts with a quick delivery down the leg, Shafali Verma tries to flick but misses and gets hit on her pads.

Fuller delivery and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and drives it firmly through covers for a brace. The umpires are checking for the run out at the non-striker's end but the replay shows that Shafali Verma is safe.
In the blockhole and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues digs it out to the leg side.
A low full toss around middle and off, Shafali Verma skips down the track and drills it to long off for a run.
Full again and on middle, angling in, Jemimah Rodrigues looks for the drive once again but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. They cross.
BEATEN! This is full and on off, shaping away a bit, Jemimah Rodrigues goes for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length delivery around off, Shafali Verma stays back and slaps it down to long off for a single.
On a length and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it but straight to point.
Pulls her length back a bit and on off, Shafali Verma punches it of her back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Goes full and on off, Shafali Verma opens the face of her bat and guides it to point.
Bangs this short on middle and leg, Shafali Verma ducks under it. A wide called.
FOUR! Good shot! This is fuller and on off, Shafali Verma makes room and lofts it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Length delivery around middle, Shafali Verma blocks it out.
On a length and way outside off, Shafali Verma moves across to play at it but ends up leaving it. Wide called.
SIX! HUGE! A short ball around off, Shafali Verma stands tall and swats this over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
This is on a length and on the leg stump, Shafali Verma works it through square leg for a single. A good powerplay for India as they are 50-1.
FOUR! Up and over! This is full and on middle, Shafali Verma chips it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
WIDE! A full ball outside off, further shaping away, Shafali Verma leaves it alone. Wided.
FOUR! This time she connects and connects well. This is full and outside off again, Shafali Verma stays there and drives this past point for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! This is back of a length and outside off, Shafali Verma tries to cut it from her crease but misses.
Goes short and on middle, Shafali Verma tries to pull but mistimes it towards mid on.
Aaliyah Alleyne starts with a length delivery on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it towards cover-point and gets across for a quick single.
Aaliyah Alleyne is into the attack.
Swing and a miss! Shamilia Connell drops it short now, outside off. Shafali Verma looks to pull this one but she misses. Good over for Barbados Women, only 1 run off it.
Single now! This one angles in, on her pads. Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike!
Make that four dots! Another length delivery, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues dabs it towards point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it towards mid off. She wanted a single there but is sent back. Three dots on the trot now!
Another length ball, angling in this time, around middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards square leg.
A length ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues fends this one to point.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Shafali Verma looks to drive this one but she misses.

FOUR BYES! Bonus runs for India Women! A length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma slashes at it but she misses. Kycia Knight the keeper fails to grab the ball as well. It runs away towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Fullish and wide of off. Shafali Verma gets under it and tonks it over cover for another boundary in the over!
Wide! Shanika Bruce errs in line and spills it down the leg side. Wide called!
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A full toss, around off. Shafali Verma smashes it down the ground for a boundary.
Low full toss, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full this time, on her pads. Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards square leg for a single.
In the air...and safe! A shorter ball, around middle. Shafali Verma looks to pull this one but the ball goes off her top edge over the fielder at short fine leg. Two taken!

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Width on offer this time, slightly shorter. Shafali Verma slaps this towards cover-point. Trishan Holder gets low and tries to stop the ball but it goes through her legs and towards the boundary ropes! First boundary for Shafali Verma!
Quick single! Another length ball, tailing back in, around middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues taps it towards mid-wicket and runs across to the other end.
This one nips back in, on a good length, around middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to block this one but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad.

FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it and cuts it late towards third man. Shai Carrington runs to her left, puts in a dive but fails to stop the ball. A boundary!
Slightly shorter now, outside off. Shafali Verma dabs it towards point for a single.
Pitches up, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives this one again but finds the fielder at mid off. End of a successful first over from Shanika Bruce!
FOUR! Classy! She hits it from the middle of the bat this time! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues leams forward and creams her drive through cover for a boundary.
A low dipping full toss, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives this but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to drive this one but she fails to get any connection on that.
THREE WIDES! Fuller ball, swinging away, down the leg side. The keeper fails to grab the ball and it rolls away. The batters take two runs more!
Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Shanika Bruce strikes and draws first blood! A huge, huge wicket this for Barbados Women and a perfect start for them as well. A yorker-length delivery, flighted around middle. Smriti Mandhana shuffles across and tries to hoick this one over but she misses and gets rapped on her pads. An appeal for LBW now, but the umpire disagrees! Hayley Matthews opts for a review! Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates three reds! Smriti Mandhana has to walk back!

A stumping chance! Shanika Bruce begins with a fuller ball, shaping away, outside off. Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the pitch and looks to go ove rcovers but she misses. The keeper who was standing up collects the ball and whips the bails off. Smriti Mandhana does exceedingly well to bring her back foot back in the crease.
A stumping appeal! Ultra Edge shows no bat while the replay shows Smriti Mandhana stretched her back foot well to stay in the crease.
Shanika Bruce to bowl from the other end.
Back to over the wicket, a short ball, outside off. Shafali Verma ducks and lets that go through. 5 runs in the opening over!

Shamilia Connell goes 'round the wicket now, serves a shortish ball, angling down leg. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards the fielder at square leg. A little fumble there allows the batters to cross ends.
Touch fuller, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! India Women and Smriti Mandhana are underway in style! On a length again, around middle. Smriti Mandhana uses the depth of her crease, swivels, and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
A length delivery this time, angling in, around middle. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
Shamilia Connell begins with a fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana presses forward and drives it towards cover.

All set for the action. A must win game for both the teams and both will hope for a positive start. The two umpires walk out to the middle. Hayley Matthews leads her team as they stride out. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma - the openers for India Women.  Shamilia Connell to start with the ball. Here we go...

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women says that Pooja Vastrakar is back in the side and they are really happy and excited to have her back. Mentions that they look like a well-balanced unit. They played some good cricket in the previous game and they are looking forward to doing the same in this game. Informs that they have another change as well, Taniya Bhatia replaces Yastika Bhatia.

Hayley Matthews the captain of Barbados Women says they will bowl first. Says it is a great opportunity to restrict India to a low total. Mentions it is unfortunate not to have Deandra Dottin for West Indies but she is available for Barbados Women. Informs that they have made one change. Shares that it is a great tournament to play. The players are playing under pressure but have done really well till now.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Pooja Vastrakar (In for Sabbhineni Meghana), Taniya Bhatia (WK) (In for Yastika Bhatia), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Sneh Rana, Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.

Barbados Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews (C), Kycia Knight (WK), Kyshona Knight, Aaliyah Alleyne, Trishan Holder, Alisa Scantlebury, Shakera Selman, Shaunte Carrington (In for Keila Elliott), Shamilia Connell, Shanika Bruce.
TOSS - Barbados Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

Barbados Women have had a different story as compared to their opposition in this game. They won their first game against Pakistan Women but were handed a crunching defeat against the mighty Australia Women in their previous game. Barbados Women need step up with the bat and score big this time around. Their experienced players will need to take matters into their own hands and put on a strong show. Their Flamboyant player, Deandra Dottin who recently left the world in shock by announcing her retirement from international cricket, will have to display her magic. Hayley Matthews and her troops will need to put their best foot forward in this must-win clash. Who do you think will progress into the next stage? We will know soon. Stick around for the toss and other updates.
